sentences.text: The genus Anomalipes, meaning 'unusual foot', contains only one known species, Anomalipes zhaoi, which is known from a partial hindlimb.
Its name highlights the peculiar shape of the dinosaur's foot.
The remains were discovered within a Shantungosaurus bonebed at the Kugou locality, and the specific name zhaoi honors the person Zhao Xijin.
This specimen is smaller than typical caenagnathids but larger than is typical for the other main oviraptorosaurian clade, Oviraptoridae.
Anomalipes is classified within the family Caenagnathidae and belongs to the infraclass Oviraptorosauria.
Anomalipes zhaoi lived during the Late Cretaceous Campanian stage, approximately 75 million years ago, in what is now Asia, with a time range estimated between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago.
